domains.E: FIR quashing; civil dispute dressed as crime (cheating, forgery, breach of trust)
domains.H: Violent crime: murder, hurt, evidence, sentence
domains.I: Special-statute arrest and bail: PMLA, UAPA, SC/ST, corruption
domains.J: After conviction: appeal, suspended sentence, remission, parole

questions.text: Police picked up my brother last night from Andheri after his car hit a scooter, they just said 'come with us' and took his phone, no paper nothing, my mother is crying since morning. Today they took him to magistrate for remand. The lawyer says it's fine but I read online they must give reasons?? Is this arrest even legal, can we get him out because they gave nothing in writing?
Police sent me a notice on WhatsApp under section 35 BNSS to come to the station tomorrow in a cheating case. Is a WhatsApp notice valid? Can they arrest me if I don't go?
What are the mandatory obligations of the arresting officer under Sections 41B, 41D and 50A CrPC, and what are the consequences of non-compliance in light of the D.K. Basu requirements?
Whether an order of anticipatory bail under Section 438 CrPC must necessarily be limited in time or until the filing of the charge-sheet, or whether it may continue till the end of trial.

my father is in jail since 88 days in a CBI bank fraud case. CBI filed chargesheet on day 87 but says investigation against 'other accused' is still going on and they didn't even give us copy of chargesheet yet. Our lawyer is saying we can get default bail under section 187 BNSS because chargesheet is incomplete, citing some Ritu Chhabaria case. Someone else told me that case was stopped by Supreme Court. Please tell what is the actual position, we are very confused.

My nephew is first time accused in a 2023 theft case, he's been in jail as undertrial for over a year. Does the new section 479 BNSS one-third rule help him even though the FIR was before the new law?

I gave my old friend 6 lakhs cash for his shop, he gave cheque, it bounced, case going on in Margao court for four years now. Now suddenly he is ready to pay the cheque amount but my lawyer says he will have to pay 10% or 15% extra to settle as per some 2010 Supreme Court rules. His evidence is not recorded yet. How much extra does he actually have to pay, and can court close it even if I want to punish him?
In my cheque bounce case the magistrate ordered me to pay 20% interim compensation on the very first date. Is that compulsory?

Where the payee presents a dishonoured cheque through his account at the branch of his bank in Delhi, though the cheque is drawn on a Kolkata bank, which court has territorial jurisdiction to try the complaint?
Whether a prosecution under the NDPS Act stands vitiated merely because the informant/complainant police officer also conducted the investigation.
NCB made my cousin sign a statement in their office saying the ganja was his. Can they use that as his confession in court?

We had oral deal to sell our godown in Kanpur, buyer paid part only and then stopped, after one year we sold to someone else. Now the buyer's wife filed FIR under 420 and 406 IPC and even 354 against my mother!! Police filed chargesheet also. Magistrate earlier itself said it was civil matter. We never cheated anyone, it was their default. Can High Court quash this, and how long will this harassment go on?

questions.text: Parameters governing the exercise of inherent jurisdiction under Section 528 BNSS to quash non-compoundable offences on the basis of a settlement in a predominantly commercial dispute.
My business partner filed a cheating FIR against me because I couldn't return the money he invested after the business made a loss. Can this FIR be cancelled?
questions.half_basis: linked to ruler topic T02, T10

questions.text: My daughter-in-law left our house in Meerut in March 2025 and now filed case under section 85 and 86 BNS against my son, me, my husband and even my married daughter in Pune. I am 64 with sugar problem. Neighbours say police will come and arrest all of us. I read there is family welfare committee and 2 month no-arrest rule?? Is that true or was it cancelled? We never asked for any dowry.
My husband threw me out of the house three years ago. Is it too late to file a domestic violence case now?
What are the essential ingredients to sustain a charge under Section 306 IPC, and does persistent matrimonial harassment without a proximate act of instigation suffice?
A man touched my 12-year-old daughter's chest over her clothes. Someone said it's not POCSO because there was no skin contact. Is that right?

My daughter is 16, her teacher misbehaved with her in school and touched her wrongly, we filed police case. Now the whole village and the school trust is pressuring my husband, he signed some compromise paper, and the teacher's people say High Court will cancel the FIR because of compromise. I don't want to compromise, my daughter is scared to go to school. Can they really close the case like this?
Whether consensual sexual relations on a promise of marriage that was later broken constitute rape, and how Section 69 BNS alters the position for conduct after 1 July 2024.
Whether a certificate under Section 63 BSA (formerly Section 65B Evidence Act) is a mandatory condition for admissibility of CCTV footage where the original device is not produced.

My younger brother was convicted under 302 IPC for killing two people in 2019 village land fight and the sessions court gave death sentence in 10 days after conviction, the judge didn't even ask about his background, he has a small child, he was never in trouble before, works in the jail bakery now. We are poor, the legal aid lawyer barely met him. Can the High Court change it to life? What can we show?
In a parking fight my neighbour hit a man once on the head with a stick and he died in hospital. Will this be murder?

ED questioned my father 4 times in 2023 but never arrested him. Now the special court has taken cognizance of their complaint and sent summons. Our CA says the moment he walks into court ED will arrest him and he'll need to pass those impossible twin conditions for bail that Supreme Court upheld in 2022. Should he just not go? We are terrified.
Whether anticipatory bail under Section 438 CrPC is maintainable in a case under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, and whether a preliminary enquiry or approval is required before arrest.
Standard for suspension of a sentence of life imprisonment pending appeal under Section 430 BNSS, and whether the appellate court may re-appreciate evidence at that stage.

My uncle has done 16 years in Lucknow jail on a life sentence, his jail conduct is very good, he made furniture, other prisoners with less time already got out. Jail people told him he must give an application himself for remission but he doesn't know how and we live in Bihar and can't come often. Is it true that without application nothing will happen? Who has to start the process?
Me and my wife both want divorce by mutual consent. Can the court skip the 6-month waiting period?
Does Section 38 BNSS entitle an arrested person to have his advocate physically present throughout custodial interrogation?
Police registered FIR in Aug 2024 under 420 and 406 IPC for a fraud done in March 2024. What are the new BNS sections for these and what is the punishment?

rules.seal: a question that shares a case, or sits in the same doctrine group, with a ruler topic takes that topic's side (a frozen topic means sealed); the remaining questions are ordered inside each domain by SHA-256(seed|id) and sealed until ceil(n/3) of the domain is sealed (forced ones count towards that)
rules.sealed: neither searched nor marked until the final run; select hands it out once and logs it

index_snapshot.note: The experiment runs on this index only; a changed head is refused by the pool runner.

provenance.statement: Owner, 2026-10-09: the questions were 'retrieved from real legal scenarios and from recognised government websites'. Checked: the story questions retell the reported case they test (Q1, Q7, Q12, Q19). They are not client messages, and the file does not say which question came from which page.
provenance.label: re-told from reported cases and government sources (owner's statement); not client messages; per-question source not recorded
provenance.reading: every figure from this set is a best case: a question that describes the case it is meant to find is easier than a real client's

freeze.note: Written before any search was run on these questions. Run once, at the end, with `select --half sealed --final`.
